_comment: Curated brand -> product lines. A line is assigned when its text appears in the product name (word-boundary match, spacing/punctuation insensitive); longest match wins. Keys starting with _ are ignored; the key "*" applies to every brand. Grow this from `python evals/enrich/audit.py --db` — it is the cheapest, most durable accuracy fix available, since assignment becomes a string fact instead of a model judgment. Seeded from The Plug (Crown Heights) product names.
